name: Corporate Relocation
intro: Coordinators and counselors who manage relocations end to end and keep transferees and their families moving on schedule.

roleDetails.text: Manages each move from start to finish: schedules services, coordinates vendors and keeps the transferee updated at every step.
Sets up home-finding, school searches and area tours, and helps transferees settle into the new city.
Walks transferees through their benefits and the move process, and answers their questions along the way.
Handles international assignments: immigration steps, shipments and the paperwork for each move.
Processes relocation expenses, checks them against policy and gets reimbursements paid on time.
